sentences.en: When she has a headache, the slightest noise irritates her.
sentences.zh: 她头痛的时候， slightest noise 都会让她烦躁。

sentences.en: The way he looked at me irritated me very much.
sentences.zh: 他看我的眼神让我非常烦躁。

sentences.en: Am I right in assuming that my commentaries irritate you?
sentences.zh: 我猜猜对了，我觉得我的评论让你很烦躁？

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ir（加强）+rit（擦）+ate→摩擦→激怒
